name: @d3ara1n/pi-peek-agent
description: Cross-instance peek for pi — built on @d3ara1n/pi-mesh. Registers an 'ask' handler that answers remote peeks via @d3ara1n/pi-peek's read-after-burn consult, plus the `peek` LLM tool. Discovery, transport, and identity live in pi-mesh.
